The text never places that PTH value literally before surgery, and the caption may refer to the plotted data, so this is recorded as an ambiguity, not a source conflict: the text value stays included and the caption claim is review_only. iPTH markers drawn in Figure 1b are pixel content only and are not used to settle it.

The excised mediastinal lesion is called an ectopic parathyroid gland with hyperplasia in the histology sentence but an ectopic parathyroid adenoma in the figure caption and discussion. Both wordings are kept; no equivalence is asserted beyond the authors' own labelling.

The biopsy sentence reads "with nor pleomorphism or necrosis", probably a typographical error for "no". It is recorded as a review_only observation and not as asserted absent pleomorphism or necrosis.

The source states the effect of imatinib on calcium normalization was confounded by denosumab, and the discussion states the mechanism of hypercalcemia could not be definitively elucidated. GIST-associated hypercalcemia is recorded as the authors' diagnosis without attributing normalization to imatinib alone.
